title: Daily Devotional #53
paragraphs: As I read through Luke 9, I am struck by the many miracles that Jesus performed. He healed the sick, fed the hungry, and even raised the dead. Yet, even as He performed these incredible acts, He reminded His disciples to take up their cross and follow Him.

It's easy to get caught up in the miracles and forget the call to discipleship. We may desire the power to heal and perform miracles, but are we willing to take up our cross and follow You? It's a challenging call, but one that we cannot ignore.
Lord, I pray that You would give me the courage to take up my cross and follow You. Help me to put aside my desires for power and recognition and instead seek to serve and love others as You did.

In Luke 9, we also see Peter confessing that Jesus is the Messiah. Yet, even as he makes this confession, Jesus reminds him and the other disciples that the Son of Man must suffer and be rejected. This was not the kind of Messiah that the people were expecting, but it was the Messiah that they needed.

Lord, help me to remember that Your ways are not our ways. Your plans are far greater than ours, and we need to trust in You even when we don't understand. Help me to have the faith to follow You, even when it means suffering and rejection.

As I close this devotional journal, I am reminded of Your love for us. You sent Your Son to die for us, so that we could be reconciled to You. Help me to live my life in response to that love, taking up my cross and following You each day.
